title: DPAA Remembers Fallen Comrades on 20th Anniversary of Mi-17 Helicopter Crash- Vietnam B-Roll
description: The Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency (DPAA) hosted a memorial service in honor of 16 service members that lost their lives in a Mi-17 helicopter crash while out on mission on Apr. 7, 2001. The ceremony was conducted at the memorial near the crash site in Quang Binh Province, Vietnam, April 7, 2021. DPAA’s mission is to achieve the fullest possible accounting for missing and unaccounted-for U.S. personnel to their families and our nation (U.S. Army video by Staff Sgt. Michael O'Neal)
keywords: Vietnam, DPAA, Mi-17 Helicopter Crash, Defense POW/MIA Acconting"
